## playwright-test-generator — CANNOT_COMPLETE/BLOCKED **Scenario B-S3 is rejected: the application does not provide the capability the approved outcome requires.** No candidate spec was written, no locator was invented, and no passing test was emitted. ### What is missing Sign-in-free, automatic cross-profile **Cloud Sync**. In this application Cloud Sync is a per-user feature gated behind OAuth sign-in: the sync engine is only started for an authenticated session, and every `/api/sync/*` handler requires a session.
